verified_behaviors: native ClaimRun, RenewLease, ReadRun, ReadVersion and CompleteRun
durable same-payload replay and divergent payload rejection
per-worker run, version, lease and reply isolation
separate worker process knows only endpoint and scoped token
owner restart preserves completion idempotency and rejects a new operation using an old lease
worker cannot request arbitrary owner file paths as artifacts
limitations: per-worker disposable loopback gateway; no shared-service deployment
bearer scope is issued by trusted owner; no production identity/federation qualification
artifact upload/staging is outside the command transport
read calls are observations, not durable mutation receipts
these are storage and transport checks, not training speed or semantic evaluation
